sentences.japanese: 皆さんが気に病む必要はありません。
sentences.english: You don't have to trouble yourselves.

sentences.japanese: ほとんど全ての人は治療で死に、病のゆえではない。
sentences.english: Nearly all men die of their remedies, and not of their illness.

sentences.japanese: 病は気からとはうまく言ったものですね。
sentences.english: It is aptly said that illness starts from the mind.

sentences.japanese: 王を得た麒麟もまた寿命を持たない生き物だが、この病ばかりは治癒の方法がない。
sentences.english: A qilin with a king too has no limit on its lifespan, but this illness alone admits of no remedy.

sentences.japanese: 恋は悲しみに満ちた病であり、あらゆる治療をも薬をも受け付けない。
sentences.english: Love is a sickness full of woes, All remedies refusing.
